segments.text: Healthcare products and services | Amazon Ads Support Center Skip to main content Update to Fire TV Measurement Methodology : On October 8, 2026, Fire TV is updating its measurement methodology. Reported totals will no longer include impressions and clicks that do not align with the updated measurement criteria. Across Fire TV display supply, this update impacts approximately 15% of impressions and 11% of clicks. Individual advertiser impact will vary based on campaign, marketplace, and placement mix. All Fire TV impression forecasts have been updated, and reporting will follow the updated methodology. This update is aligned with MRC standards. Updated on Apr 6, 2026 Healthcare policies apply to consumer healthcare products (for example, over-the-counter medicines and medical devices, herbal and dietary supplements, and personal care products), prescription pharmaceuticals, and healthcare services. Ads for healthcare products and services must follow all applicable local laws and regulations. Ads may be limited by placement, supply, or scheduling restrictions. Prohibited products and services Clinical trial recruitment or experimental medical treatments Syringes with needles or other invasive products designed to draw liquid or blood Medical devices marketed for professional use Health claims and comparative statements Advertisers must accurately represent their products. This includes ensuring that all implicit and explicit claims made in the ad copy, audio, or visuals are accurate, truthful, not misleading, and, when appropriate, backed by scientific evidence. Refer to the Claims and Substantiation policy guidelines for details on requirements. Consumer healthcare products The following policies apply to consumer healthcare products. Consumer healthcare products include over-the-counter medicines and medical devices, herbal and dietary supplements, and personal care products. These products don’t require a doctor’s prescription, are bought off-the-shelf in stores such as pharmacies or grocery stores and may be regulated by local regulatory authorities. Supply-specific restrictions Supply-specific policies for consumer healthcare products vary to protect the customer experience. Requirements are defined by product categories as follows (non-exhaustive list). Product types Supply-specific restrictions Targeting restrictions* Category 1 (low sensitivity products): Generally allowed Allergy and Sinus, Splints and Supports, Breast Pump, Cough and Cold, COVID Test Kits, Digestion, Eczema, Eye health, Foot Remedies, General Stress, General Wellness Health Tests or Monitors, Menopause, Menstruation Products, Physical Therapy Aids, Pain Relievers, Rosacea, Sleep or snoring Aids, and others. Permitted on all supply with the following restrictions: Amazon O&O Streaming TV must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, and G (review content rating guidelines ) Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Category 2 (medium sensiti

vity products): Allowed with restrictions Denture care, head lice treatments, Hearing, Mobility and Visual Aids, Psoriasis, Smoking Cessation, Weight Loss, and others. Fire TV , Fire tablet , Alexa , Amazon store homepage : prohibited Amazon O&O Streaming TV : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, and G (review content rating guidelines ) Twitch and IMDb : homepage prohibited Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Audience creation related to purchase/views of these products is prohibited Use of Advertiser Audiences - audiences built from advertiser data via AMC or direct DSP upload - is prohibited Category 3 (high sensitivity products): Allowed with additional restrictions Adult Incontinence, Alcohol tests, Anxiety Support, Breathing Trainers and Monitors, Breathalyzers, Condoms, Diabetes Support, Erectile Dysfunction Medication, Family Planning and Reproductive Health, Fat Burners, Metabolism Boosters, Appetite Suppressants, and GLP-1 Supplements, Hangover Support, Intimate Care Products, Lubricants, Naloxone Nasal Spray, Skin Tag and Wart Removers, Speech and Communication Aids, testosterone or libido boosters, and others. Fire TV , Fire tablet , Alexa , Amazon store homepage : prohibited Amazon store : contextual placement is required Prime Video Display : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, G, and PG/TVPG (review content rating guidelines ) Twitch and IMDb : homepage prohibited Amazon Music Free : must exclude Children's Music genre and Kids podcasts Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Audience creation related to purchases or views of these products is prohibited. Use of Advertiser Audiences - audiences built from advertiser data via AMC or direct DSP upload - is prohibited. *Targeting restrictions apply to all supply types. Sexual wellness products are category 3 consumer healthcare products that are allowed with additional restrictions. This includes products related to safer sex, sexual performance, and intimate personal care. Country-specific restrictions may apply. Supply-specific restrictions: Amazon store Display ads must be placed within the Sexual Wellness section of the site. Amazon O&O Streaming TV (condoms and lubricants): ads must daypart content rated PG13/TV14 to only show ads between 9 PM and 6AM and exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, G, and PG/TVPG (review content rating guidelines ). Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Prescription pharmaceuticals Prescription pharmaceuticals are drugs prescribed or administered by a doctor or healthcare professional. Ads for prescription pharmaceuticals are reviewed on a case-by-case basis and permitted in the United States, New Zealand, and Canada only. In addition, awareness campaigns from prescription pharmaceutical manufacturers that do not contain any reference to specific pharmaceutical products are permitted in the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Germany, and Spain. The use of audience targeting is restricted. Requirements are defined by medication categories as follows (non-exhaustive list). Pharmaceutical product category (condition supported) Supply-specific restrictions Category 1 (moderate sensitivity): Allowed with restrictions Allergies, Arthritis, Asthma, Blood Pressure, Bronchitis, Cirrhosis, Constipation, Coronary Artery Disease, Crohn's disease, Diabetes, Dupuytren’s Contracture, Epilepsy, Fibromyalgia, Glaucoma, Hair Loss, Hemorrhoid, Insomnia, Irritable Bowel Disease or Syndrome, Meningitis, Menopause, Metabolic Bone Disease, Migraine/headache, Movement disorders, Overactive Bladder, Pneumonia, Psoriasis, RSV, Sclerosis, Shingles, and Smoking Cessation Permitted on the following placements with restrictions (as shown): Fire TV , Fire tablet , Alexa , IMDb , Twitch Amazon O&O Streaming TV : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, and G (review content rating guidelines ). usic and podcasts Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Category 2 (higher sensitivity): Allowed with additional restrictions ADHD, Alzheimer, Anxiety, Bipolar Disorder, Cancer, Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD), Depression, Erectile Dysfunction, Hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, HPV, Parkinson, Peyronie’s Disease, Birth Control, Tuberculosis, and Weight Loss Twitch : prohibited on homepage, sponsored streams, and mobile in-feed Amazon O&O Streaming TV : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, and G, PG/TVPG (review content rating guidelines ) Amazon Music Free : must exclude kids' music and podcasts Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Healthcare services may include practitioners, hospitals and institutions, health clinics, online pharmacies, telemedicine services, or other services devoted to wellness or care of health conditions/disease. Supply-specific restrictions Healthcare services such as practitioners or hospitals/institutions: Amazon O&O Streaming TV : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, and G (review content rating guidelines ) Amazon Music Free : must exclude kids' music and podcasts Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Healthcare services related to mental health, sexual wellness, addiction, cosmetic procedures, weight loss, or end-of-life: Amazon store : Prohibited Amazon Music Free : must exclude kids' music and podcasts and daypart from 7PM to 6AM. Amazon O&O Streaming TV : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, G, and PG/TVPG (review content rating guidelines ) Twitch and IMDb : off-homepage Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Online pharmacies and telemedicine: Note : Ads for online pharmacies are accepted only in the US, when registered with the NABP, as well as Sweden and Germany when a EU Common logo is present on the landing page and reflects relevant registration. Amazon store Display ads : Prohibited Amazon Music Free : must exclude kids' music and podcasts Amazon O&O Streaming TV : must exclude content rated NR, TV-Y, TV-Y7, and G (review content rating guidelines ) Open Internet : permitted with accurate category declaration Targeting (all healthcare services for all supply types) Audience creation related to purchase/views of these services is prohibited. Use of Advertiser Audiences - audiences built from advertiser data via AMC or direct DSP upload - is prohibited. Country-specific restrictions Ads must promote only the products and services that are permitted by the local regulatory authorities for the condition treated in each of the countries where the ads will run. It's the advertiser’s responsibility to ensure that legal requirements, including disclaimers and all information necessary for the correct and appropriate use of the product, are present. The below country-specific healthcare requirements apply (a non-exhaustive list): Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, Morocco, Oman, Qatar Egypt, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, and Turkey Was this article helpful?
